Marcus — thanks for flagging. Olivia — welcome. We can do this but there are two paths; choice depends on timing and audit trail you prefer. 

Option A — Invoice offset (preferred if customer needs net-zero on the Nov invoice):
- We can apply the $12,500 as an invoice offset only if we process before 11/25 close.
- Accounting will post a contra-revenue memo and route the offset through Suspense-Promotions (GLA 6100-9999) until revenue is finalized. After month-close, we will reverse from Suspense into the appropriate revenue contra GLA.
- Action items: Marcus to confirm by 11/20 EOD. We will need PO/approval from Streampath (attached doc qualifies).

Option B — Credit memo (preferred if outside close window or you want a document trail independent of invoice):
- We issue a formal credit memo referencing invoice # (if posted) or as a standalone proforma credit. This will be touched as a receivable credit and posted against Allowance for Promotions (GLA 2201).
- Requires approval from Revenue Ops for >$10k credits; route: Chloe -> Revenue Ops -> Finance Controller. Lead time ~3 business days.

Trial extension: operationally fine. Sales should email contracts@redwood.com to update SOW dates. No accounting impact unless credits are linked to usage thresholds; if so, note in the credit memo reference.

Attachments: I included a short GLA mapping cheat-sheet and the internal approval matrix.

Will proceed on Option A if Marcus confirms before EOD 11/20. If not, we'll default to Option B and route the credit memo for sign-off.

-Neha\Finance Manager, Revenue Operations\Redwood Inference
